articles.title: Here's what bitcoin and ether traders are doing ahead of the binary U.S. CPI print

articles.title: Harmony’s ONE dives 26% after attack appears to create tokens equal to quarter of supply

articles.title: Dogecoin and BNB lead majors higher as bitcoin slips near $63,700
articles.description: DOGE gained almost 3% to 7 cents and BNB 2% to $614, while bitcoin was the only major in the red on both the day and the week.

articles.title: XRP bridge drained for $200,000 after software mistook fake deposits for real ones
articles.description: An attacker created unbacked XRP on another blockchain, then exchanged it for real XRP held in reserve. The bridge has been halted and its operator has filed a complaint with the FBI.

articles.title: Bitcoin stuck as ETF inflows offset selling, but inflation data could spark a move

articles.title: Brazil's largest lender Itaú is stepping deeper into the tokenization
articles.description: Itaú Unibanco said it teamed up with tokenization specialist OpenAssets to test tokenized bonds and funds in a pilot run by Brazil's financial watchdog ANBIMA.

articles.title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
articles.description: The trading platform’s gross crypto revenue fell to $1.35 billion in the second quarter. It also agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

articles.title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large

articles.title: Crypto-friendly bank Erebor in talks to raise $1.5 billion at $9.5 billion valuation: FT
articles.description: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.

articles.title: Pokémon cards are becoming multibillion dollar market. Crypto wants to fix how they trade
articles.description: Collectors are spending millions on trading cards, while blockchain startups are turning physical Pokémon cards into digital assets. The harder task is creating enough liquidity to compete with established marketplaces.

articles.title: MoneyGram expands on Solana with global crypto-to-cash service

articles.title: Ravencoin, a blockchain built from Bitcoin’s code, could roll back four days of transactions
articles.description: Two mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hashpower are building a replacement chain from before Friday’s first invalid block, putting deposits, withdrawals and payments made since then at risk of reversal.

articles.title: Coinbase picks Abu Dhabi for its global tokenized asset push
